notes.title: Update Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
It has come to my attention that certain monsters are unable to be fought in new game plus, as such, I had made it so that certain boss mmebers who you could not re-fight would be added back into the Color12's stats at the start of new game plus, and to anyone who would like to get them back. simply visit the cave for a moment.

Also I have fixed the problem with The  purse problem for every other playthorugh. 

To anyone who still has it, you can sell it, think of it as a "thank you" for helping me realize that was happening.
